scenario.title: Progress, human attention and recovery
situations: Work is running and the user wants a small status update.
A worker is quiet or blocked and the operator does not know why.
A conversation ends or work resumes on another session.
The user wants to pause, park or abandon work.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Current teaching and checkpoint contracts inspected; no live quiet-worker, pause or cross-session recovery exercised.
Existing dashboard wake limitations vary by harness; defer to manifest-owned capabilities rather than promise automatic desktop resume.
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.

lessons.title: Find the next decision without reading the whole dashboard
lessons.when: Once work is active, or when the user asks what needs their attention.
lessons.need: Frontier explains ready, active and blocked work; Inbox holds specific asks; item pages and Shipping hold evidence. A notice is not a request for approval.
lessons.surface: Existing dashboard surfaces and Steer status replies
lessons.gap: No dedicated learning situation in the current catalog. Review question: should JOURNEYS add first-running-work and first-human-decision cues with one relevant deep link?

lessons.title: Resume the durable checkpoint
lessons.when: After interruption, compaction, session handoff or return on another machine.
lessons.need: Preserve item Progress Logs, plan live status, checklist rows and owning run IDs. Reload the live skill phase and state rather than restarting from the transcript or assuming silence means completion.
lessons.surface: Onboard resume; Steer loop/close-out; Wrapup checkpoints
lessons.gap: Review question: should JOURNEYS add interrupted-work recovery and FIRST-USER D prove a fresh session can continue the handoff without duplicated work?

lessons.title: Distinguish pause, hold and cancellation
lessons.when: When the user asks to stop, pause, park, abandon or resume current work.
lessons.need: Freezing parks an item without changing its lifecycle; blocking records an unmet condition; cancellation abandons work. Stopping a steering session still owes safe handoff of live operations.
lessons.surface: Help helpers; Steer held-work and close-out instructions
lessons.gap: Review question: should Help translate stop this into the appropriate current subject and consequence instead of requiring users to know the state command?
